s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection
salient_findings: Recent history of trauma to the forehead
key_facts: Presented with a tender nodule on her forehead
History of bumping her forehead on an air-conditioning unit several months prior
Denied fever, neck stiffness, and photophobia
Lived alone with a pet cat and spent minimal time outdoors
No recent exposure to systemic steroids
Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts

raw.syndrome_frame: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection
salient_findings: Recent history of trauma to the forehead
key_facts: Presented with a tender nodule on her forehead
History of bumping her forehead on an air-conditioning unit several months prior
Denied fever, neck stiffness, and photophobia
Lived alone with a pet cat and spent minimal time outdoors
No recent exposure to systemic steroids
Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts

shortlist.label: Cutaneous cryptococcosis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts, consistent with Cryptococcus neoformans infection

shortlist.label: Primary cutaneous cryptococcosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presented with a tender nodule on the forehead, which is a common presentation for primary cutaneous cryptococcosis

shortlist.label: Sporotrichosis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead, which could be consistent with sporotrichosis, although less likely given the biopsy results

shortlist.label: Chromoblastomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection, which could be consistent with chromoblastomycosis, although less likely given the biopsy results

shortlist.label: Phaeohyphomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation, which could be consistent with phaeohyphomycosis, although less likely given the biopsy results

raw.rationale: The patient's skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts, consistent with Cryptococcus neoformans, and the absence of systemic symptoms or positive blood cultures suggests a localized infection, which is more consistent with primary cutaneous cryptococcosis

rejected.label: Cutaneous cryptococcosis
rejected.why: While the patient has cutaneous involvement, the term is broader and does not specify the primary site of infection

rejected.label: Sporotrichosis
rejected.why: The skin biopsy results do not match the typical findings of Sporotrichosis, which usually shows a mix of suppurative and granulomatous inflammation

rejected.label: Chromoblastomycosis
rejected.why: The biopsy results do not show the characteristic sclerotic bodies seen in Chromoblastomycosis

rejected.label: Phaeohyphomycosis
rejected.why: The biopsy results do not show the characteristic pigmented hyphae seen in Phaeohyphomycosis
